hypothesis: A 96-thread CTA (three full warps) may improve scheduling versus the 256-thread baseline while preserving one thread per target. More CTAs may also increase scheduling overhead, so this intermediate block size is a measurement point, not an assumed gain.
notes: Only launch geometry changes; the kernel, force equations, traversal, and memory strategy remain unchanged. The baseline measured 0.0018526411283622502 seconds. Earlier correct 12-, 24-, and 48-thread candidates measured faster, but their results are not monotonic and do not predict this configuration. The controller should validate all supported cases before comparing official timings.
transformations: Set block and items_per_block to 96, with shared_memory_bytes remaining 0; preserve the exact launch JSON key set.
